contributions.basis: cover-line1-cumulative (== cover-line1-this == Form A printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS)
contributions.detail: Two Form A rows, 2,000.00 + 5,000.00 = 7,000.00. That equals the Form A printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS cell (written '7000'), the cover's Total THIS Report cell (written '7,000 -', trailing dash after whole dollars per core sec.3(g) => 7,000.00) and the cover's Cumulative Report cell (written '7,000' with superscript '00' => 7,000.00). Total LAST Report is a slashed zero, so this is the filer's FIRST report of the cycle and the THIS and CUMULATIVE scopes COINCIDE - recorded as cumulative per addendum sec.B. Cover anchors recorded as '0' where the filer drew a slashed-Oe zero glyph (core sec.3(f) zero-glyph ruling); the verbatim glyph is a slashed Oe in blue ink.

expenditures.basis: cover-line2-cumulative (Form B line; == cover-line2-this == Form B printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES)
expenditures.detail: Form B (p3) is an entirely blank 18-row grid - not one inked data cell. All three cover expense cells carry a slashed-Oe zero glyph = 0 (core sec.3(f)). The Form B TOTAL EXPENDITURES cell carries a RED slashed-Oe drawn by the reviewing clerk (same red ink as the clerk's other annotations on this filing); the filer himself left it blank. Zero rows is a real zero, not a gap. Scopes coincide (first report of the cycle).

gates.page_subtotal: p2 rows 2,000.00 + 5,000.00 = 7,000.00 = printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS '7000' - gates exactly. p3 has no rows and its printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES cell holds a nil mark - gates trivially at 0.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p2 geometry_status=ok, 20 h-rules -> 19 bands at 3.114% pitch. Band i=1 (y 33.59, h 3.20) is the TWO-LINE HEADER row ('Date | Name of Donor | Amount | In Kind? Y/N'), verified by crop: the 1200dpi crop at y=36.86% renders row 1's amount. So bands 2..19 = 18 data rows, of which 2 are inked = 2 rows emitted. p3 grid is the same shape, 0 inked.
gates.geometry_proof: p2, amount column x=56.06..81.71 (rowbands v_rules). First-row box (y 36.80, h 3.16) crop renders '2,000 00'; last-row box (y 39.96, h 3.14) renders '5,000 00'; control box one pitch below (y 43.10) renders EMPTY. Confirms the row index is not shifted.
gates.balance_chain: Cover balance line: LAST and THIS balance cells were left blank by the filer (only the form's printed '-' shows); Cumulative balance = 7,000.00. 0 (beginning) + 7,000.00 (contributions) - 0 (expenses) = 7,000.00 = the printed cumulative balance - CLOSES EXACTLY. No earlier filing by this filer in this cycle is in my chunk (Total LAST Report = 0 says there is none), so no cross-filing chain test was possible.

escalation_note: p2 1200 dpi cell crops: row1 amount, row2 amount, control band, and a wide 1200 dpi crop of the row1+row2 date+donor bands. p3 1200 dpi crop of the TOTAL EXPENDITURES cell to decide whether the red mark was a nil glyph or a numeral.

contributions.note: Written '2,000' with superscript '00' over the cents position => 2000.00 (core sec.3(g)). Date written 12/2/2025. Donor is the candidate himself. In Kind? column answered 'N'. This Gen-2 Form A has no mailing-address column, so donor_city/donor_state are structurally unavailable, not withheld.

Written '5,000' with superscript '00' => 5000.00; the leading glyph is a cursive 5 (open-top), confirmed by the arithmetic: 2,000 + 5,000 = 7,000 = the printed TOTAL and both cover cells. Donor read at 1200dpi as 'Doug Dennett'; the third glyph of the first name is a bistable cursive u/n so 'Dong' cannot be excluded - hence donor=medium. Date cell reads '12/11/2025'; the middle group is two vertical strokes read as 11 - date=medium. In Kind? column answered 'N'.
